title: Under-five mortality, 1990–2020 (World, South Asia, Sub-Saharan Africa) and SDG target 3.2

sources.title: World Development Indicators: Mortality rate, under-5 (per 1,000 live births) (SH.DYN.MORT)
sources.note: 原始提供者：UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation（UN IGME）。數值由 api.worldbank.org（country WLD、SAS、SSF）取得，取 1990、2000、2010、2020 四年

sources.title: Goal 3: Ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all at all ages

facts.text: Under SDG target 3.2, every country should cut its under-5 death rate to 25 or fewer per 1,000 live births by 2030.
SDG target 3.2 also aims to end preventable deaths of newborns and young children by 2030.
All UN member states adopted the 2030 Agenda and its 17 Sustainable Development Goals in 2015.
